helper_set.description: Exact gpuwm 2.9.0 radiation helpers, measured by the engine repin at 0db047465. Admission establishes source identity only; it does not claim unchanged forecast numerics.

manifest_source: checked engine commit and matching published platform wheels
measurement_note: Re-measured 2026-10-15, after gpuwm 2.9.0 reached PyPI: every row comes from the wheels PyPI serves, the 2.9.0 row from its three platform wheels (py3-none-any, manylinux_2_28_x86_64, win_amd64), and v2.9.0 is the public engine repository's tag, commit 0db047465987a31b955e201b132a40620804633d. The seam manifest, glacier digest, contract surface, helper set and requirement are those of the 2026-10-14 pre-publication measurement, which was taken from a wheel built before the tag existed; only the build commit moved. Running this engine repin without --write against PyPI exits 1 if a published wheel ever carries other seam bytes, another glacier digest or another helper set.
